recipes.notes:
11/25/2025; 10.7% ABV

Breakdown of the calculation:
1. Alcohol Content
Planteray O.F.T.D. Rum (69% ABV): Contributes 2.76 oz of pure alcohol.
Michter's Bourbon (45.7% ABV): Contributes 1.83 oz of pure alcohol.Note: This calculation assumes Michter's US1 Small Batch Bourbon.*
Cognac (40% ABV): Contributes 1.60 oz of pure alcohol.

Total Pure Alcohol: ~6.19 oz

2. Total Recipe Volume
Liquids: 30 oz (Milk & Cream) + 12 oz (Spirits) + 1 oz (Vanilla) = 43 oz
Eggs: ~10.1 oz (estimated volume of 6 large eggs)
Sugar: ~5.0 oz (volume added when 237g of sugar is dissolved)
Total Batch Volume: ~58.1 oz (approx. 1.72 Liters)

Calculation:  6.19oz (Total Alcohol) / 58.1oz (Total Volume) = approx 0.1065 = 10.7% ABV

Serving Note: This batch yields slightly less than a half-gallon. While 10.7% ABV is comparable to a strong wine, the richness of the dairy and eggs can mask the alcohol, so it packs a hidden punch!

recipes.name: Van Gogh's Anti-Insanity Lemon Tonic
recipes.prep:
IN A CHILLED 12oz. COLLINS GLASS, POUR THE CASSIS OR CHAMBORD INTO THE BOTTOM OF THE GLASS. 

ADD THE LEMON SYRUP. IT WILL  SINK TO THE BOTTOM CREATING A LAYER OF SYRUP AND LIQUEUR. DO NOT STIR.

FILL THE GLASS FULL WITH ICE. 

ADD THE LEMONADE, POURING GENTLY SO THAT THE BOTTOM LAYERS REMAIN UNDISTURBED. 

SLOWLY POUR IN THE CHILLED VODKA TO CREATE ANOTHER LAYER. 

TOP WITH EMPRESS 1908 GIN. SERVE WITH A STRAW AND SIP FROM THE BOTTOM. GARNISH WITH RASPBERRIES AND A LEMON TWIST.
recipes.notes:
Lemon Syrup:
3 – 4 LEMONS – 1/2 CUP (120ML) JUICE
1/2 CUP (100G) SUGAR

CUT OFF AND RESERVE THE ZEST OF 1 OF THE LEMONS (AVOID THE 
BITTER WHITE PITH). 

JUICE ALL THE LEMONS UNTIL YOU HAVE 1/2 CUP OF FRESH LEMON JUICE.

COMBINE THE JUICE WITH THE SUGAR IN A SMALL SAUCEPAN 
AND BRING THE MIXTURE JUST TO A BOIL OVER MEDIUM-HIGH 
HEAT. 

REDUCE THE HEAT TO MAINTAIN A GENTLE SIMMER AND COOK 
UNCOVERED UNTIL THE SYRUP IS SLIGHTLY THICKENED, ABOUT 
10 MINUTES. 

TURN THE HEAT OFF AND ADD THE RESERVED LEMON ZEST. 
COVER AND LET IT SIT UNTIL COOL – ABOUT 20 MINUTES. 

REMOVE THE LEMON ZEST AND STRAIN THE SYRUP THROUGH A
SIEVE. WILL KEEP REFRIGERATED FOR A MONTH OR MORE.
